_comment: AlterEgoWeb configuration. All fields are optional.
_includeFlavors: Which game folders to read. Retail only by default. Use [] for all of them, or e.g. ["_retail_", "_classic_"].
_wowPaths: Force the WoW root folder(s) when auto-detection fails. Use double backslashes. Example: ["E:\\World of Warcraft"]. The launcher's tray menu can also set this with a folder picker.
_excludeAccounts: Account folder names to skip entirely, e.g. ["123456789#3"]
_accountAliases: Friendly names for the cryptic account folders. The Battle.net account name is NOT recoverable from disk, so this is the only way to label them. Example: {"L123456789": "main"}
_historyWeeksToKeep: How many weekly snapshots to retain. Each is roughly the size of your combined AlterEgo.lua files (~0.6 MB here), so 12 weeks is about 7 MB.
_absorbDownloadedSettings: Pull a settings.js you downloaded from the page out of your Downloads folder into data/ on the next scan.
_checkForUpdates: Ask api.github.com for the latest release. Only the release metadata is fetched; nothing about you is sent. Set to false for no network access at all.
_onWindowClose: What the launcher does when you close the dashboard window: "exit" quits it too, "tray" keeps it resident, "" asks once and remembers. Also settable from the tray menu.
_collectBackups: Read MySlot export strings and the edit-mode cache into data/backups.js for the 备份箱 panel.
